chunks: From him, from Ali ibn Hassān, from Mūsā ibn Bakr, who said:
I heard Abū al-Ḥasan (peace be upon him) saying: 'The gourd increases the intellect.'

key_terms.أَبُو الْحَسَنِ: Abu al-Hasan (Imam Musa al-Kadhim, peace be upon him)

ai.seo_question: What does the gourd do to the intellect according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This concise hadith from Imām al-Ṣādiq (peace be upon him) identifies the gourd (dubba') as a substance that enhances intellect (aql), reflecting the Shia tradition of linking specific foods to physical and mental benefits. It categorizes this as an ethical and scientific teaching regarding health and cognition, emphasizing the holistic view of the body and mind in Islamic medicine. The statement underscores the belief that dietary choices can directly influence cognitive faculties, a concept supported by broader Islamic medical traditions.

en.hubeali: From him, from Ali Bin Hassan, from Musa Bin Bakr who said,
‘I heard Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The gourd increases the intellect’.
en.sarwar: 5. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from Ali ibn Hassan from Musa ibn Bakr who has said the following:
“I once heard abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ‘Squash, gourd increases power of reason.’”
